functions.name: author_architecture

modules.name: architect_check MCP tool — verify model representativeness against code reality
modules.docstring: architect_check MCP tool — verify model representativeness against code reality.

functions.name: check_representativeness
functions.signature: check_representativeness(repo_path: str, model_yaml: str) -> dict[str, Any]
functions.docstring:
Check how well an architecture model represents the actual codebase.

Supports three modes:
- Hierarchical (config): uses pre-existing source_block_dict from config
- Hierarchical (auto): generates F-blocks from module grouping when no config exists
- Flat: fallback when neither hierarchical path is available

Args:
    repo_path: Absolute path to the repository root.
    model_yaml: The architecture model YAML to evaluate.

Returns:
    Dict with scores, details, and suggested improvements.

modules.name: architect_correct MCP tool — store structured architecture corrections
modules.docstring: architect_correct MCP tool — store structured architecture corrections.

functions.name: store_correction
functions.signature: store_correction(repo_path: str, correction_type: str, target: str, reason: str, suggestion: dict | None) -> dict[str, Any]
functions.docstring:
Store a structured correction for the architecture model.

Corrections are consumed on next pipeline run to improve the model.

Args:
    repo_path: Absolute path to the repository.
    correction_type: One of: split_component, merge_components, add_component,
        remove_component, add_relationship, remove_relationship, rename, reclassify.
    target: Entity ID being corrected (e.g., "COMP-3").
    reason: Why this correction is needed.
    suggestion: Optional structured suggestion (format depends on type).

modules.name: architect_decompose MCP tool — decompose model into sub
modules.docstring: architect_decompose MCP tool — decompose model into sub-models and recursive manifests.

functions.name: decompose_repository
functions.signature: decompose_repository(repo_path: str) -> dict[str, Any]
functions.docstring:
Decompose architecture model into per-block sub-models and recursive manifests.

Reads .architecture-model.yaml, traces relationships per F-block,
writes sub-models to .architecture-models/ and per-block manifests
to .architecture/manifests/.

Args:
    repo_path: Absolute path to the repository.

Returns:
    Dict with sub_models, recursive_manifests, and paths.

modules.name: architect_docs MCP tool — generate SE documentation from architecture model
modules.docstring: architect_docs MCP tool — generate SE documentation from architecture model.

functions.name: generate_docs
functions.signature: generate_docs(repo_path: str, formats: str) -> dict[str, Any]
functions.docstring:
Generate standard SE documentation from an architecture model.

Produces component specs, ICDs, dependency matrix, health report,
and index from .architecture-model.yaml.

Args:
    repo_path: Absolute path to the repository.
    formats: Comma-separated list of doc types to generate.
        Options: all, component_spec, icd, dependency_matrix, health, drift, index.
        Default: "all".

Returns:
    Dict with generated file paths and any errors.

modules.name: architect_export MCP tool — export flat files for mobile AI consumption
modules.docstring: architect_export MCP tool — export flat files for mobile AI consumption.

functions.name: export_repository
functions.signature: export_repository(repo_path: str, output_dir: str, output_format: str, prefix: str) -> dict[str, Any]
functions.docstring:
Export repository architecture as flat files for mobile AI.

Builds a set of flat files (model, sub-models, docs, manifests, specs,
diagrams, skills, reference docs) suitable for use in token-limited
AI environments.

Args:
    repo_path: Absolute path to the repository.
    output_dir: Where to write output. Default: {repo_path}/.architecture-export/
    output_format: "dir" (flat directory) or "zip" (single zip file).
    prefix: File prefix override. Default: auto-derived from repo name.

Returns:
    Dict with file list, sizes, and output location.

modules.name: architect_extract MCP tool — validate and store an architecture extraction
modules.docstring: architect_extract MCP tool — validate and store an architecture extraction.

functions.name: store_extraction
functions.signature: store_extraction(repo_path: str, model_yaml: str, context_tokens: int) -> dict[str, Any]
functions.docstring:
Validate and store an architecture model extraction.

Called AFTER the agent has produced a YAML architecture model.
Validates the model, writes it to .architecture-model.yaml,
and records telemetry.

Args:
    repo_path: Path to the repository root (where to save the model).
    model_yaml: The YAML architecture model produced by the agent.
    context_tokens: How many tokens of context the agent used (for telemetry).

Returns:
    Dict with: stored (bool), score (int), issues (list), telemetry_recorded (bool),
    pipeline (dict), warnings (list).

functions.signature: record_feedback(repo_path: str, feedback_type: str, content: str, context: dict | None, rating: int | None, correction: dict | None) -> dict[str, Any]
functions.docstring:
Record user feedback to .architecture/feedback.jsonl.

modules.name: architect_generate MCP tool — run tests on generated code
modules.docstring: architect_generate MCP tool — run tests on generated code.

functions.name: run_tests_on_generated_code
functions.signature: run_tests_on_generated_code(repo_path: str, test_command: str | None) -> dict[str, Any]
functions.docstring:
Run the repository's test suite against generated code.

This is the quality gate for code generation. The agent generates code,
then calls this tool to verify it passes the original tests.

Args:
    repo_path: Path to the repository with generated code + tests.
    test_command: Custom test command. Defaults to pytest.

Returns:
    Dict with: passed (bool), pass_rate (float), total_tests (int),
    passed_tests (int), failures (list of failure descriptions).

modules.name: architect_group MCP tool — group repository modules into logical components
modules.docstring: architect_group MCP tool — group repository modules into logical components.

functions.name: group_repository
functions.signature: group_repository(repo_path: str, target_groups: int) -> dict[str, Any]
functions.docstring:
Group repository modules into logical architecture components.

Uses multi-signal affinity (subdirectory, name-prefix, imports) to
cluster source files into coherent component groups. This provides
suggested component boundaries for architecture extraction.

Args:
    repo_path: Absolute path to the repository root.
    target_groups: Desired number of groups. 0 = auto-calculate.

Returns:
    Dict with keys: groups, total_modules, total_groups, filtered_trivial.
    Each group has: name, files, file_count, locked.
    Returns {"error": "..."} on failure.

functions.name: scan_repository
functions.signature: scan_repository(repo_path: str) -> dict[str, Any]

Scan a repository and generate its reality manifest.

modules.name: architect_slice MCP tool — compress repository context for LLM consumption
modules.docstring: architect_slice MCP tool — compress repository context for LLM consumption.

functions.name: compute_adaptive_budget
functions.signature: compute_adaptive_budget(module_count: int, base: int) -> int
functions.docstring:
Scale token budget with repository size.

Small repos (<=20 modules): base budget (4000 tokens)
Medium repos: +200 tokens per 10 modules over 20
Large repos: capped at 16000 tokens

Examples:
    20 modules → 4000 tokens
    50 modules → 4600 tokens  
    100 modules → 5600 tokens
    161 modules → 6800 tokens
    500 modules → 16000 tokens (capped)

functions.name: slice_context
functions.signature: slice_context(repo_path: str, focus: str, budget: int, detail: str) -> str
functions.docstring:
Generate an optimized context slice from a repository.

This is the core token-arbitrage function. It compresses a full repository
into a dense, structured context string within the token budget.

If an .architecture-model.yaml exists, uses the model + slicer + formatter.
Otherwise, falls back to manifest-based context.

Args:
    repo_path: Absolute path to the repository root.
    focus: Focus scope - "all", an source-block ID (e.g. "F1"), a layer name,
           or an artifact name (e.g. "icd", "requirements-analysis").
    budget: Maximum token budget (1 token ~ 4 chars).
    detail: Detail level - "minimal", "standard", or "full".

Returns:
    Formatted context string within budget, or error message.
